punchline: In his famous bout with Jim Jeffries, Jack Johnson answered every insult with a smile and a punch.
thirty_sec: Jack Johnson fought Jim Jeffries, the Great White Hope, hated by his opponent and the crowd. He smiled and joked, and built his plan around the abuse, answering each insult with another blow. When a punch split his lip he kept smiling. Round by round Jeffries grew angry and tired and lost the will to fight. Ryan Holiday uses it for amor fati: not just accepting what happens, but feeling good about it.
